title: GET|PUT /api/v1/memory/extract-consent
description: The tenant's mem:extract@1 register row (m1_092, 16 §L1): whether memory extraction may send certified sessions to Nebius Token Factory through the platform llm-router. Absence is the default (enabled=false with the static disclosure); PUT enabled=true writes the row, PUT enabled=false revokes it. judge_id is the m1_065 register key column.
